**Visual observations from test image:**
- Green soybean leaf lying on soil
- 2-3 small dark brown/black circular lesions near the base/lower portion with yellow discoloration around them
- One lesion in the upper area appears to have dried and fallen out, leaving a "shot-hole" appearance

**Key diagnostic features:**
- The shot-hole appearance (tissue falling away from center) is characteristic of **Frogeye leaf spot**
- Small circular dark spots with yellow halos match frogeye description
- Reference images confirm: small circular dark spots on green leaves with shot-hole centers, identical pattern to test image

The frogeye reference collage shows the exact same pattern: small dark circular spots on otherwise green leaves, some with holes where the center has fallen out — matching the test image perfectly.
